rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something was done fairly well or pretty well.

example.english: I did my report respectably, and my boss even praised me.
example.traditional: 我份報告做得幾好，老闆都讚我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fan6 bou3 gou3 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2 lou5 baan2 dou1 zaan3 ngo5

rows.note: Use this slice when “respectably” specifically means politely or respectfully towards other people.

example.english: They treated the guests respectably, and everyone felt comfortable.
example.traditional: 佢哋有禮貌咁招呼啲客，大家都覺得舒服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jau5 lai5 maau6 gam3 ziu1 fu1 di1 haak3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this slice for carrying something out or presenting oneself in a decent, respectable, presentable way.

example.english: They dressed respectably for the interview, which made a much better impression.
example.traditional: 佢去見工嗰日着得體面，印象分高好多。
example.jyutping: keoi5 heoi3 gin3 gung1 go2 jat6 zoek6 dak1 tai2 min6 jan3 zoeng6 fan1 gou1 hou2 do1
